core.changelog: Shows the saved titles of active Codex chats, scrolls long titles, and opens the selected conversation from the Touch Bar.

community.pock.widgets.betternowplaying.changelog: Pauses playback updates while the widget is hidden, reduces background polling and continuous animations, and keeps scrolling track text clear of album artwork.

community.pock.widgets.dock.changelog: Keeps running app state in sync so closed apps disappear smoothly and running-only Dock layouts stay current.
